game.q: two sneezes. only one gets a blessing. why?
opts: one sneeze was way more dramatic

wrong.loud: a strong sneeze, but volume wasn’t the point.
wrong.tissue: good manners, but not the reason here.

game.right: YES. only one praised God. the blessing answered the praise, not the sneeze.

end.line: two men sneezed. one said alhamdulillah, and a habit was born.
